description: Convert a Korean HWP or HWPX (한글) document to Markdown: paragraphs, outline headings, tables. Pass exactly one of path | url | base64. 한글 문서를 마크다운으로 변환합니다. Use whenever a user gives you a .hwp/.hwpx file or link (공문, 계약서, 입찰서류). Needs the file location.

base64.description: Base64 file contents (for clients that cannot share a path)

maxChars.description: Truncate output beyond this many characters

name: hwp_to_markdown
